subject: English
question: Choose the correct simple present form: Neither the superintendent nor the clerks _____ the keys to the record room.
explanation: With 'neither...nor', the verb agrees with the nearer subject, 'clerks'. Therefore, 'keep' is required despite the singular first subject.
explanation_pa: 'neither...nor' ਨਾਲ verb ਆਪਣੇ ਨੇੜਲੇ subject 'clerks' ਦੇ ਅਨੁਸਾਰ ਆਉਂਦੀ ਹੈ। ਇਸ ਲਈ ਪਹਿਲਾ subject singular ਹੋਣ ਦੇ ਬਾਵਜੂਦ ਇੱਥੇ 'keep' ਆਵੇਗੀ।

subject: English
question: Choose the correct simple present form: A pair of scissors _____ kept beside the dispatch register.
explanation: The head noun 'pair' is singular, so 'is' is required. Scissors alone takes a plural verb, but 'a pair of scissors' takes a singular verb.
explanation_pa: ਮੁੱਖ noun 'pair' singular ਹੈ, ਇਸ ਲਈ 'is' ਆਵੇਗੀ। ਇਕੱਲੇ 'scissors' ਨਾਲ plural verb ਆਉਂਦੀ ਹੈ, ਪਰ 'a pair of scissors' ਨਾਲ singular verb ਆਉਂਦੀ ਹੈ।

subject: English
question: Using British English collective-noun agreement, choose the pair that best matches the stated meanings in the simple present: The jury, acting as a single body, _____ one verdict; the committee, sharply divided among themselves, _____ conflicting personal views.
explanation: A collective noun acting as one unit takes a singular verb, giving 'delivers'. When members are explicitly viewed as divided individuals, British English permits plural agreement, giving 'express'.
explanation_pa: ਜਦੋਂ collective noun ਇੱਕ ਇਕਾਈ ਵਜੋਂ ਕੰਮ ਕਰਦਾ ਹੈ, ਤਾਂ singular verb 'delivers' ਆਉਂਦੀ ਹੈ। ਜਦੋਂ ਮੈਂਬਰਾਂ ਨੂੰ ਸਪਸ਼ਟ ਤੌਰ ’ਤੇ ਵੱਖੋ-ਵੱਖ ਵਿਅਕਤੀਆਂ ਵਜੋਂ ਦੇਖਿਆ ਜਾਂਦਾ ਹੈ, ਤਾਂ British English ਵਿੱਚ plural verb 'express' ਵਰਤੀ ਜਾ ਸਕਦੀ ਹੈ।

subject: English
question: Choose the pair that correctly completes both clauses in the simple present: None of the equipment _____ without electricity, whereas all of the emergency lamps _____ on batteries.
explanation: 'None of' followed by the uncountable 'equipment' requires singular 'works'. 'All of' followed by plural 'lamps' requires plural 'run'.
explanation_pa: 'None of' ਤੋਂ ਬਾਅਦ uncountable noun 'equipment' ਹੈ, ਇਸ ਲਈ singular verb 'works' ਆਵੇਗੀ। 'All of' ਤੋਂ ਬਾਅਦ plural noun 'lamps' ਹੈ, ਇਸ ਲਈ plural verb 'run' ਆਵੇਗੀ।

subject: English
question: Choose the correct simple present form: Ten kilometres _____ too far for an injured runner to cover on foot.
explanation: A distance viewed as one total amount takes a singular verb. Here, ten kilometres represents one distance, so 'is' is required.
explanation_pa: ਜਦੋਂ ਦੂਰੀ ਨੂੰ ਇੱਕ ਕੁੱਲ ਮਾਤਰਾ ਵਜੋਂ ਲਿਆ ਜਾਂਦਾ ਹੈ, ਤਾਂ singular verb ਆਉਂਦੀ ਹੈ। ਇੱਥੇ ਦਸ ਕਿਲੋਮੀਟਰ ਇੱਕ ਦੂਰੀ ਨੂੰ ਦਰਸਾਉਂਦਾ ਹੈ, ਇਸ ਲਈ 'is' ਆਵੇਗੀ।

subject: English
question: Choose the correct simple present form: The rich _____ a greater share of the cost under this proposal.
explanation: 'The rich' denotes rich people collectively and takes a plural verb. Thus 'bear' is correct; 'bears' wrongly treats the group expression as singular.
explanation_pa: 'The rich' ਅਮੀਰ ਲੋਕਾਂ ਨੂੰ ਸਮੂਹਿਕ ਤੌਰ ’ਤੇ ਦਰਸਾਉਂਦਾ ਹੈ ਅਤੇ ਇਸ ਨਾਲ plural verb ਆਉਂਦੀ ਹੈ। ਇਸ ਲਈ 'bear' ਸਹੀ ਹੈ; 'bears' ਇਸ ਸਮੂਹ ਨੂੰ ਦਰਸਾਉਣ ਵਾਲੇ ਪ੍ਰਗਟਾਵੇ ਨੂੰ ਗ਼ਲਤੀ ਨਾਲ singular ਮੰਨਦਾ ਹੈ।

subject: English
question: Choose the pair that correctly completes the sentence in the simple present: More than one trainee _____ that two-thirds of the allotted time _____ spent on checking measurements.
explanation: 'More than one' followed by a singular noun normally takes a singular verb, giving 'reports'. A fraction of uncountable 'time' also takes a singular verb, giving 'is'.
explanation_pa: 'More than one' ਤੋਂ ਬਾਅਦ singular noun ਹੋਵੇ ਤਾਂ ਆਮ ਤੌਰ ’ਤੇ singular verb ਆਉਂਦੀ ਹੈ, ਇਸ ਲਈ 'reports' ਆਵੇਗੀ। Uncountable noun 'time' ਦੇ ਕਿਸੇ ਹਿੱਸੇ ਨਾਲ ਵੀ singular verb ਆਉਂਦੀ ਹੈ, ਇਸ ਲਈ 'is' ਆਵੇਗੀ।

subject: English
question: Choose the pair that correctly completes the sentence in the simple present: The circulars which _____ revised instructions, as well as the covering letter, _____ the director's signature.
explanation: 'Which' refers to plural 'circulars', requiring 'contain'. The main subject is also 'circulars'; the 'as well as' phrase does not change it, so 'bear' is required.
explanation_pa: 'Which' ਦਾ ਸੰਬੰਧ plural noun 'circulars' ਨਾਲ ਹੈ, ਇਸ ਲਈ 'contain' ਆਵੇਗੀ। ਮੁੱਖ subject ਵੀ 'circulars' ਹੈ; 'as well as' ਵਾਲਾ phrase ਇਸ ਨੂੰ ਨਹੀਂ ਬਦਲਦਾ, ਇਸ ਲਈ 'bear' ਆਵੇਗੀ।

subject: English
question: Choose the pair that correctly completes both clauses in the simple present: Some of the luggage _____ to the visiting athletes, while some of the sealed parcels _____ to their coach.
explanation: With 'some of', the following noun determines agreement: uncountable 'luggage' takes 'belongs', while plural 'parcels' takes 'belong'. The same quantifier does not require the same verb form in both clauses.
explanation_pa: 'some of' ਨਾਲ ਅੱਗੇ ਆਉਣ ਵਾਲੇ noun ਅਨੁਸਾਰ verb ਚੁਣੀ ਜਾਂਦੀ ਹੈ: uncountable 'luggage' ਨਾਲ 'belongs' ਅਤੇ plural 'parcels' ਨਾਲ 'belong' ਆਵੇਗੀ। ਇੱਕੋ quantifier ਹੋਣ ਦਾ ਮਤਲਬ ਇਹ ਨਹੀਂ ਕਿ ਦੋਵਾਂ clauses ਵਿੱਚ verb ਦਾ ਰੂਪ ਵੀ ਇੱਕੋ ਹੋਵੇ।

subject: English
question: Choose the correct simple present form: Mathematics _____ a compulsory component of this recruitment examination.
explanation: Mathematics names a field of study and takes a singular verb despite its final 's'. Therefore, 'is' is required.
explanation_pa: 'Mathematics' ਪੜ੍ਹਾਈ ਦੇ ਇੱਕ ਵਿਸ਼ੇ ਦਾ ਨਾਂ ਹੈ ਅਤੇ ਅੰਤ ਵਿੱਚ 's' ਹੋਣ ਦੇ ਬਾਵਜੂਦ ਇਸ ਨਾਲ singular verb ਆਉਂਦੀ ਹੈ। ਇਸ ਲਈ 'is' ਆਵੇਗੀ।

subject: English
question: Choose the correct simple present form: The principal, along with two invigilators, _____ the examination halls every hour.
explanation: An 'along with' phrase does not change the number of the subject. The singular 'principal' requires 'inspects', not 'inspect'.
explanation_pa: 'along with' ਵਾਲਾ phrase subject ਦਾ number ਨਹੀਂ ਬਦਲਦਾ। Singular subject 'principal' ਨਾਲ 'inspects' ਆਵੇਗੀ, 'inspect' ਨਹੀਂ।

subject: English
question: Choose the pair that correctly completes both clauses in the simple present: Harleen is one of those officers who _____ every disputed entry, but she alone _____ the final correction.
explanation: 'Who' refers to the plural 'officers', so the first verb is 'check'. The second subject is the singular 'she', which requires 'authorises'.
explanation_pa: 'Who' ਦਾ ਸੰਬੰਧ plural noun 'officers' ਨਾਲ ਹੈ, ਇਸ ਲਈ ਪਹਿਲੀ verb 'check' ਆਵੇਗੀ। ਦੂਜਾ subject 'she' singular ਹੈ, ਇਸ ਲਈ ਇਸ ਨਾਲ 'authorises' ਆਵੇਗੀ।

subject: English
question: Choose the pair that correctly completes the sentence in the simple present: Every inspector and every constable _____ a badge that _____ a unique identification number.
explanation: Singular subjects joined by 'and' take a singular verb when each is introduced by 'every', so 'wears' is required. 'That' refers to the singular 'badge' and takes 'carries'.
explanation_pa: 'and' ਨਾਲ ਜੁੜੇ singular subjects ਵਿੱਚੋਂ ਹਰੇਕ ਤੋਂ ਪਹਿਲਾਂ 'every' ਹੋਵੇ ਤਾਂ singular verb ਆਉਂਦੀ ਹੈ, ਇਸ ਲਈ 'wears' ਆਵੇਗੀ। 'That' ਦਾ ਸੰਬੰਧ singular noun 'badge' ਨਾਲ ਹੈ, ਇਸ ਲਈ 'carries' ਆਵੇਗੀ।

subject: English
question: Choose the correct simple present form: There _____ three vacant posts in the revenue office.
explanation: In this construction, the verb agrees with the following subject, 'three vacant posts'. That plural subject requires 'are', not 'is'.
explanation_pa: ਇਸ ਬਣਤਰ ਵਿੱਚ verb ਆਪਣੇ ਤੋਂ ਬਾਅਦ ਆਉਣ ਵਾਲੇ subject 'three vacant posts' ਦੇ ਅਨੁਸਾਰ ਆਉਂਦੀ ਹੈ। ਇਹ subject plural ਹੈ, ਇਸ ਲਈ 'are' ਆਵੇਗੀ, 'is' ਨਹੀਂ।

subject: English
question: Choose the pair that correctly completes both clauses in the simple present: Dev is the only one of the volunteers who _____ the old script, and the documents that he translates _____ valuable historical evidence.
explanation: In 'the only one ... who', the relative clause singles out 'one', requiring 'understands'. The plural subject 'documents' takes 'provide'.
explanation_pa: 'the only one ... who' ਵਿੱਚ relative clause ਖ਼ਾਸ ਤੌਰ ’ਤੇ 'one' ਵੱਲ ਸੰਕੇਤ ਕਰਦਾ ਹੈ, ਇਸ ਲਈ 'understands' ਆਵੇਗੀ। Plural subject 'documents' ਨਾਲ 'provide' ਆਵੇਗੀ।

subject: English
question: Choose the correct simple present form: These trousers _____ too loose for the recruit.
explanation: Trousers is a plural noun and takes 'are'. A singular verb would be appropriate with 'a pair of trousers', which is not the subject here.
explanation_pa: 'Trousers' ਇੱਕ plural noun ਹੈ, ਇਸ ਲਈ ਇਸ ਨਾਲ 'are' ਆਵੇਗੀ। Singular verb 'a pair of trousers' ਨਾਲ ਠੀਕ ਹੁੰਦੀ, ਪਰ ਇੱਥੇ ਇਹ subject ਨਹੀਂ ਹੈ।

subject: English
question: Choose the correct simple present form: Most of the information supplied by the helpline _____ accurate.
explanation: With 'most of', agreement follows the noun referring to what is being measured. Information is uncountable and singular, so 'is' is required.
explanation_pa: 'most of' ਨਾਲ verb ਉਸ noun ਦੇ ਅਨੁਸਾਰ ਆਉਂਦੀ ਹੈ ਜਿਸ ਦੀ ਮਾਤਰਾ ਦੱਸੀ ਜਾ ਰਹੀ ਹੈ। 'Information' uncountable ਅਤੇ singular ਹੈ, ਇਸ ਲਈ 'is' ਆਵੇਗੀ।

subject: English
question: Choose the correct simple present form: Many a passenger _____ this connection because the first train arrives late.
explanation: 'Many a' is followed by a singular noun and a singular verb. Hence 'misses' is required despite the expression referring to numerous passengers.
explanation_pa: 'Many a' ਤੋਂ ਬਾਅਦ singular noun ਅਤੇ singular verb ਆਉਂਦੀ ਹੈ। ਇਸ ਲਈ ਕਈ ਯਾਤਰੀਆਂ ਦੀ ਗੱਲ ਹੋਣ ਦੇ ਬਾਵਜੂਦ 'misses' ਆਵੇਗੀ।

subject: English
question: Choose the correct simple present form: 'Gulliver's Travels' _____ on the upper shelf of the college library.
explanation: A title referring to a single book takes a singular verb, even if it contains a plural word. Therefore, 'is' agrees with this title.
explanation_pa: ਇੱਕ ਕਿਤਾਬ ਦੇ title ਨਾਲ singular verb ਆਉਂਦੀ ਹੈ, ਭਾਵੇਂ ਉਸ title ਵਿੱਚ ਕੋਈ plural ਸ਼ਬਦ ਹੋਵੇ। ਇਸ ਲਈ ਇਸ title ਨਾਲ 'is' ਆਵੇਗੀ।

subject: English
question: Choose the correct simple present form: One of the buses on the Ludhiana route _____ near the district hospital.
explanation: The subject is the singular 'one', so the verb is 'stops'. The plural noun after 'one of' does not make the subject plural.
explanation_pa: Subject 'one' singular ਹੈ, ਇਸ ਲਈ verb 'stops' ਆਵੇਗੀ। 'one of' ਤੋਂ ਬਾਅਦ ਆਉਣ ਵਾਲਾ plural noun subject ਨੂੰ plural ਨਹੀਂ ਬਣਾਉਂਦਾ।

subject: English
question: Choose the correct simple present form: The furniture in these government quarters _____ regular maintenance.
explanation: Furniture is an uncountable singular noun and takes 'requires'. 'Quarters' belongs to a modifying phrase and does not determine agreement.
explanation_pa: 'Furniture' ਇੱਕ uncountable singular noun ਹੈ, ਇਸ ਲਈ ਇਸ ਨਾਲ 'requires' ਆਵੇਗੀ। 'Quarters' ਇੱਕ modifying phrase ਦਾ ਹਿੱਸਾ ਹੈ ਅਤੇ verb ਦੀ ਚੋਣ ਇਸ ਦੇ ਅਨੁਸਾਰ ਨਹੀਂ ਹੁੰਦੀ।

subject: English
question: Choose the correct simple present form: Each of the applicants _____ required to produce an identity card.
explanation: Each is singular even when followed by 'of + plural noun', so it takes 'is'. The plural noun 'applicants' does not control the verb.
explanation_pa: 'Each' singular ਹੁੰਦਾ ਹੈ, ਭਾਵੇਂ ਇਸ ਤੋਂ ਬਾਅਦ 'of + plural noun' ਹੋਵੇ, ਇਸ ਲਈ ਇਸ ਨਾਲ 'is' ਆਵੇਗੀ। Plural noun 'applicants' ਦੇ ਅਨੁਸਾਰ verb ਨਹੀਂ ਚੁਣੀ ਜਾਂਦੀ।

subject: English
question: Choose the correct simple present form: The number of complaints received through the portal _____ unusually high.
explanation: 'The number of' has the singular head noun 'number' and takes 'is'. It differs from 'a number of', which takes a plural verb.
explanation_pa: 'The number of' ਵਿੱਚ ਮੁੱਖ noun 'number' singular ਹੈ, ਇਸ ਲਈ 'is' ਆਵੇਗੀ। ਇਹ 'a number of' ਤੋਂ ਵੱਖਰਾ ਹੈ, ਜਿਸ ਨਾਲ plural verb ਆਉਂਦੀ ਹੈ।

subject: English
question: Choose the correct simple present form: A number of candidates _____ additional practice before the typing test.
explanation: 'A number of' means 'several' and takes a plural verb with 'candidates'. Hence 'need' is correct, whereas 'needs' incorrectly treats the expression as singular.
explanation_pa: 'A number of' ਦਾ ਅਰਥ 'several' ਹੈ ਅਤੇ 'candidates' ਨਾਲ ਇਸ ਲਈ plural verb ਆਉਂਦੀ ਹੈ। ਇਸ ਲਈ 'need' ਸਹੀ ਹੈ, ਜਦਕਿ 'needs' ਇਸ ਪ੍ਰਗਟਾਵੇ ਨੂੰ ਗ਼ਲਤੀ ਨਾਲ singular ਮੰਨਦਾ ਹੈ।

subject: English
question: Choose the correct simple present form: Either the guards or the caretaker _____ the museum gate at nine every morning.
explanation: The nearer subject in 'either...or' is the singular 'caretaker', which takes 'opens'. The plural 'guards' does not control this verb.
explanation_pa: 'either...or' ਵਿੱਚ verb ਦੇ ਨੇੜੇ ਵਾਲਾ subject 'caretaker' singular ਹੈ, ਇਸ ਲਈ 'opens' ਆਵੇਗੀ। Plural noun 'guards' ਦੇ ਅਨੁਸਾਰ ਇਹ verb ਨਹੀਂ ਚੁਣੀ ਜਾਂਦੀ।
